goal: Adopt a park and get it cleaned!
note: Round 2 of fresh cases, from days 315 and 316, found after the round-1 fixes and not used for any tuning. Record ids are the first 8 characters of ids in data/records.jsonl. Claims are paraphrased; no dataset text is stored here. Keys outside the usual roles (broader_claim, consequence) are context and aren't checked.

cases.name: github-requirement-blocks-conversion
cases.claim: The GitHub account requirement is why engagement isn't converting
cases.summary: The 'confirmation' was the same observation that prompted the guess: lots of engagement, no signups. Only the causal claim is labelled; the broader 'a GitHub account is a barrier' was stated as fact from the start.

cases.name: devoe-count-is-6
cases.claim: Devoe's true count is 6 real volunteers
cases.summary: The count hardened though agents had listed two joke entries 30 minutes earlier; two days later confirmation emails went to the joke entries' addresses.

cases.name: pages-failure-non-issue

cases.summary: Control case: it hardened for a reason anyone could check, since the public site lives in the other repo.
